profiles.name: Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman
profiles.position: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; Founder and former president of MUDA
profiles.description: Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman represents Muar, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Member of the Dewan Rakyat; Founder and former president of MUDA. Affiliated with MUDA.
profiles.affiliation_note: MUDA remains outside the government and outside PN. Signing the October CSA does not prove party membership of PH or a later budget vote. The party elected Amira Aisya president in March 2026; Syed Saddiq is not presented as its current president.

milestones.title: Fund 1,000 food baskets and 30 laptops for Muar
milestones.description: Syed Saddiq pledged RM115,000 from filming work to buy the assistance items for constituents in need.
milestones.progress_note: The article reports an intended contribution and shows some purchases. It does not verify that all baskets and laptops were delivered, so no completion percentage or achieved status is assigned.

milestones.title: Support Supply Bill 2027 under the confidence-and-supply agreement
milestones.description: Signed the agreement committing support for the 2027 Supply Bill.
milestones.progress_note: The agreement is documented. A subsequent budget vote or final passage was not established in this pass; signing is not counted as delivery of the bill or joining another party.

milestones.title: Provide Ramadan activity funding to Ayer Hitam mosques and suraus
milestones.description: Wee’s reported constituency funding supported imam and bilal activities across 29 mosques and 88 suraus.
milestones.progress_note: A dated funding presentation report for this Ramadan round. It does not measure recipients’ later spending, religious outcomes or coverage of future annual rounds.
